routing_logic.description: SAT-gated dispatch: every swarm task route is validated by Z3 SMT before execution. Unsatisfiable routes are hard-blocked at the Paladin gate — zero ambiguous dispatches.

mesh_networking.description: Conflict-free Replicated Data Type sync across the knight mesh. Least-upper-bound merge guarantees eventual consistency without coordination locks — agents diverge freely and reconverge at sync checkpoints.

inference_engine.description: Sub-2-bit quantized State Space Model running at linear O(n) scale. Ouroboros feeds self-generated tokens back as context seeds — recursive refinement loop with fixed-point convergence. Designed for edge-tier inference under memory constraints.

security_enclave.description: eBPF kernel-layer telemetry intercept with O(1) hash-map redaction. Credential patterns, PII, and classified glyphs are stripped at the syscall boundary before reaching any log sink — Iron Gate enforced at the OS level.

ANYA_Ω.routing_role: ANYA_OMEGA quality gate with safest-role routing; final arbiter on NANO expansion targets

SIR_BORRIS.routing_role: Surgical patch conductor; validates all NANO_SWARM_EXPAND diffs at AST level before ledger commit

phases.name: SAT_GATE_VALIDATION
phases.action: Z3 constraint check on proposed swarm topology — block if unsatisfiable

phases.name: CRDT_MESH_HYDRATION
phases.action: Broadcast UKG node to all active agents via Myrddin CvRDT; least-upper-bound merge

phases.name: OUROBOROS_SEEDING
phases.action: Seed Ouroboros SSM with NANO glyph as context root; begin recursive refinement loop

phases.name: AEGIS_REDACT_BIND
phases.action: Bind Aegis eBPF redaction map to all swarm telemetry sinks before expansion traffic flows

phases.name: BORRIS_AST_AUDIT
phases.action: AST-level diff audit of all files touched by expansion; reject any patch with undefined symbols

phases.name: ANYA_OMEGA_SEAL
phases.action: Quality gate — verify expansion meets Paladin Octem criteria; sign and ledger-commit

layer_bindings.L6_Governance: Aegis eBPF O(1) Redaction → Iron Gate
layer_bindings.L4_Semantic: Myrddin CvRDT Mesh Sync → UKG GraphRAG
layer_bindings.L2_Kinetic: SIR_BORRIS AST Auditor → Saltare / Cribo / Rotel
